title: should expose vLLM and OpenAI-compatible in the provider type dropdown
verifies: the provider type dropdown renders the new vLLM and OpenAI-compatible options

title: should toggle the API key required marker with the provider type
verifies: the API-key required marker shows for openai/deepseek and hides for vLLM/openai_compatible in create mode

title: should create a keyless vLLM provider
verifies: a vLLM provider saves without an API key and appears in the provider list

title: should create an OpenAI-compatible provider with a custom endpoint and API key
verifies: an openai_compatible provider persists with a user-supplied endpoint and key

title: should show an endpoint required error for OpenAI-compatible without an endpoint
verifies: saving openai_compatible without an endpoint surfaces the backend endpoint-required error

title: should preserve the stored API key when editing with a blank key
verifies: editing a provider with a blank key succeeds without clearing the stored secret

title: should not show the API key required marker in edit mode
verifies: the API-key required marker is hidden in edit mode even for openai providers

title: should close the form without persisting when cancel is clicked
verifies: cancelling the create form returns to the provider list without creating a provider
